in_sanskrit.name: विरज
in_sanskrit.meaning: क्लेशमूलम् विनिर्मूलयितुम् अर्थः, क्षीरोदके विरजित: शिव:, विराजमण्डल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who removes the root cause of afflictions, one who is subdued in the Kshirsoda (milk ocean), and Shiva's emblem (Virajamandala).

in_hindi.name: विरज
in_hindi.long_meaning: A ruler or a king, Virajamandala, and one who removes the root cause of afflictions.

in_tamil.name: விரஜ
in_tamil.meaning: அவச்சர் கொடுக்கப்பட்டதும் விரையாதவர், விரையாக உடல்களில் விரித்ததும் அவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has eliminated all obstacles, one who is victorious, and one who has separated the water (elements) in water.

in_telugu.name: విరజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who rules over everything, one who is the lord of all, and one who is the lord of all beings.

vedic_reference.note: Viraj is a name of Shiva, who is also known as Virajamandala. It is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and texts.

data.cultural_impact: The name Viraj is a Sanskrit derivative, meaning 'he who shines', radiates, or illuminates. This name holds a significant place in Hindu culture, especially in the Puranas and epics, where heroes, gods, and celestial beings embodying the qualities of strength, valor, intellect, and above all, a radiant aura were often given this name. Viraj Parekh, a renowned Indian American neuroscientist, who shares the name, is a testament to the universal appeal of this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Viraj lies in its Feminine form, Viraj, meaning 'The shining one, Radiant Goddess'. It exalts the gods and goddesses of various Hindu deities such as Vira Devi, the radiant, filial goddess of protection and nourishment, and Virahidevi, the Goddess of fertility and motherhood. The name symbolizes the inner light or the enlightenment present in an individual and serves as a constant reminder that light can never fade away - spiritually, emotionally, or materially. Ultimately, the name Viraj embodies the spiritual journey of discovering and embracing the inner radiance of one's true self that inspires personal growth and leads to personal fulfillment.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Viraj remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Devi Viraj, a teacher in Bangalore, India, shares that their name Viraj meaning "Radiant, shining one" has been a constant source of inspiration, motivating them to follow Hindu values and serve their community.
